title: Codepath authoring readiness · guidance and completion signaling

cards.title: Return one shared authoring policy at MCP initialization
cards.beforeBehavior: MCP initialization returns an inline guidance string. It describes the layout and variable attachments but does not require a final read-only readiness check or exact block attachments; separate UI instructions can drift.
cards.afterBehavior: MCP initialization returns walkthroughAuthoringInstructions from the shared policy also used by the UI. That policy requires attached Notes, named Variables and validate_walkthrough until ready is true; initialization itself still only returns instructions.
cards.reason: Keep the two authoring entry points consistent and make incomplete generated guides explicit, without claiming that an external model must obey the instructions.

notes.body: This branch builds the initialization response with an inline instruction string. It returns guidance, not an enforced completion check.

cards.title: Signal incomplete readiness to a CLI caller
cards.beforeBehavior: The CLI prints any successfully returned tool value and exits successfully. Only thrown transport/tool errors set exit code 1; a result describing an incomplete guide has no special signaling.
cards.afterBehavior: The CLI still prints the complete tool result, then sets exit code 1 when authoringCheckFailed recognizes validate_walkthrough without ready === true. Other successful tool results keep the normal exit status.
cards.reason: A script must not confuse a successful readiness request with a ready guide. Keep draft saving permissive while giving completion checks an observable failure status.

after.purpose: Print a CLI tool result and separately signal an incomplete generated-guide check.

notes.body: The returned value is printed unchanged, then authoringCheckFailed checks the tool name and ready field. For an incomplete validate_walkthrough result the CLI sets a failing exit code without rewriting the guide or its notes.

cards.title: Mark an incomplete readiness result as an MCP tool error
cards.beforeBehavior: A successful callTool response is always wrapped as MCP text content, without isError. Only thrown errors use the error envelope, so ordinary successful transport alone cannot distinguish an incomplete guide.
cards.afterBehavior: The MCP response preserves the tool result as JSON text and conditionally includes isError: true for an incomplete validate_walkthrough check. A ready check and other tools keep the ordinary success envelope.
cards.reason: Expose the same completion distinction to MCP clients as the CLI, while retaining the actionable report and leaving manual/draft workflows saveable.

after.provenance: Actual uncommitted 0.8.1 agent.mts from the supplied review-task starting snapshot (_baseline/agent.mts); not a committed revision.
after.purpose: Return the tool report with an explicit incomplete-readiness signal when applicable.

notes.body: The conditional object spread adds isError only when authoringCheckFailed returns true. It does not discard the report: content still contains the complete value, so the author can read the issues and fix the guide. This is signaling, not automatic correction or proof of explanatory quality.
